Rockstar❤️
Rockstar is not just a love story - it's the journey of pain turning into passion. Directed by Imtiaz Ali, the film follows Jordan, played by Ranbir Kapoor, a simple boy who believes true art is born from heartbreak.
What starts as a chaotic college romance slowly becomes an emotional storm of love, separation, fame, and loneliness. Heer, played by Nargis Fakhri, becomes the soul of Jordan's music and madness. Unlike typical romantic films, Rockstar shows how love can heal and destroy someone at the same time.
The movie became unforgettable because of its raw emotions, deep dialogues, magical music by A. R. Rahman, and Ranbir Kapoor's career-defining performance. Every song feels like a memory you never lived but somehow still miss.

Real...

From designer blazers to intense rivalries, Varun Dhawan made an unforgettable debut in Student of the Year - a film that wasn't just about college life, but about friendship, competition, love, and proving your worth when the whole world is watching.

Playing the charming yet emotional Rohan Nanda, Varun brought the perfect mix of attitude, humor, swag, and vulnerability that instantly made him a fan favorite. The movie follows three students chasing the prestigious "Student of the Year" trophy while dealing with friendship, betrayal, heartbreak, and ambition inside the glamorous walls of St. Teresa's College. What starts as a fun competition slowly turns into an emotional journey where relationships are tested and true personalities come out.

Directed by Karan Johar, the film became one of Bollywood's most stylish youth dramas and launched a new generation of stars into the spotlight. With iconic songs, luxury aesthetics, emotional moments, and unforgettable chemistry, the movie still feels nostalgic even years later. ★

IMDb Rating: 5.2/10

But honestly, for an entire generation, this movie was more than ratings - it was a vibe, an era, and a dream college life everyone secretly wished for.

"Some movies entertain you... some become memories."

Happy Boyfriend’s Day to the person who somehow became my favourite part of every ordinary day. ❤️
Jano, jibone kichu manush hothat kore ashe, but somehow they become a permanent part of our heart. Tumi thik temoni ekjon. Tomar sathe katano choto choto moments gulo hoyto prithibir kache ordinary, but for me, they mean more than words can explain.
Tumi amar shudhu boyfriend na tumi amar shantir jayga, amar hashir  karon, ar emon ekjon manush jar kache nijer shobta niye fire ashte iccha kore. Tomar sathe rag, obhiman, hasi, boka shobkichu miliyei jeno amader golpota ektu beshi nijer.
I don't need a perfect love story. I just want something real where we keep choosing each other, even on the ordinary days, even after the arguments, even when words fall short.
Tumi amar jiboner shobcheye shundor coincidence, ar ami secretly hope kori ei coincidence jeno kokhono shesh na hoy.
Happy Boyfriend’s Day, my jantush
